description: Precision audit of the t7qv binding-gap arc. The arc ran entirely in float64 -- both the seminormal matrices (numpy/scipy dtype=float) and, worse, the substrate parameter itself (q = mp.mpf(str(Q)) off a Python float, i.e. 17 digits). Re-measured at 200 bits with q from Q_50_DIGIT_STR. Every identity the arc asserted survives, with residuals falling from the float64 floor (~1e-15) to the 200-bit floor (~1e-60); the arc's magnitudes were accurate to ~1e-13. The conclusions stand; the arithmetic warrant offered for them did not.

data.float64_residuals_as_quoted_at_A5: {'exchangeability nnnnn |S|=2': 3.33e-15, 'exchangeability nnnnn |S|=3': 5.77e-15, 'exchangeability nnnnn |S|=4': 6.22e-15, 'size-only vs Mobius': 7.55e-15, 'additivity / reconstruction': 0.0}

caveats: A<=4 is computed here. A=5 is RE-DERIVED here from the committed 200-bit subset traces of a detached run (sidecars *.a5_exact.{pnpnn,nnnnn}.json, same engine, 2026-09-03); the probe does not recompute those traces. The homonuclear all-pairs A=6 is exact at 128 bits in the_size_only_recursion_reaches_order_six_probe; the MIXED A=6 (6Li) figures in the arc remain float64 measurements -- sign and magnitude claims with margins ~1e13 above the float64 floor, not exact, not to be quoted as exact. The float64 12-ordering sweep at A=5 is not re-run; its sign claim is covered by the two exact orderings, its ratio range is not.

200-bit precision tests ALGEBRAIC identities, which hold for every q. It buys nothing physical: Q_ERR = 9.2e-13 is q0's own stated uncertainty, so no quantity in this arc carries physical meaning below ~1e-12 at any working precision.

The float64 route is not thereby shown harmless anywhere else. It was harmless HERE because every identity tested is exact and every magnitude is O(1); a cancellation-heavy quantity would not have survived, and the arc had no way to tell the difference.

The seminormal off-diagonal uses b = sqrt(|a a' + 1|). The absolute value is a no-op: a a' = -1/[rho]^2 exactly, and a branching swap forces |rho| >= 2, so the radicand is non-negative. It is retained to mirror `build_seminormal_matrices_mp` letter for letter.
